rule: Every //# run-graphql query of the transactional tests under graphql/, unwrapped as Sui's unwrap_graphql_query does, whose reply in the test's .snap is not GRAPHQL_PARSE_FAILED. Written by TestParseGraphQLMsgServesEverySuiE2EQuery -update-sui-e2e-queries.

queries.query:
{ # Multi-get
  multiGetTypes(keys: [
    "0x2::priority_queue::PriorityQueue<0x2::coin::Coin<0x2::sui::SUI>>",
    "0x2::coin::Coin<0x2::sui::SUI>",
    "0x2::token::Token<0x2::sui::SUI>",
    "0x2::balance::Balance<0x2::sui::SUI>",
    "u64",
    "vector<u64>",
    "vector<0x2::coin::Coin<0x2::sui::SUI>>",
    "0x2::coin::Coin<0x2::doesnt::EXIST>",
  ]) {
    repr
  }
}

{ # Unhappy path, type arguments too deep.
  type(type: """
      vector<vector<vector<vector<
      vector<vector<vector<vector<
      vector<vector<vector<vector<
      vector<vector<vector<vector<
          vector<u8>
      >>>>
      >>>>
      >>>>
      >>>>
      """) {
          abilities
      }
}
